notes.title: LIRE Remake Character Plan
notes.content:
Hi everyone it's been a months since my last update. I want to share my planning about the character in LIRE remake. 

So I have planning to change the main character (Eve) to the new one (re-design Eve). Here's my plan :

1. I have plan to hire new artist to handle new Eve. After I discuss with the artist, at least I need around  74,000円 (Yen) or around 531$. This is to make Eve Sprite with various action. 

I have a problem with budget since I got layoff and I can't make enough money for life and even for budgeting this project. Hopefully I can gather a donate to hire this artist to make new Eve.

The name for the artist is SuperPig and you can see his/her art in [url=https://www.pixiv.net/en/users/15231158]Here[/url]

I'm open for donation that you can send it directly to my paypal account: zheroisland@gmail.com


2. If the donation is failed I will change the plan to use my own art. But I don't know if I can make it better or even worse from current Eve, also I will take a long time since I need to added extra work in my list to handle the art will cause the LIRE remake going longer to finish.

Let me know what you think.
